title: Public Alert No. 024/2026 – Alert on Counterfeit Augmentin 625mg Tablets (Batch No. AC3N) in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Augmentin 625mg Tablets (2 x 7 pack), Batch No. AC3N, circulating in Nigeria. GSK confirmed falsification: the sample's manufacturing/expiry dates (Sept 2025/Sept 2028) don't match records, with packaging text errors and poor fin seals.
